CLOCK (r4m gate 18:28 FAIL TT/FF pin-flop spread 114.6/106.8): clock_split_km K=8 made 8 local BUFx24 roots over clusters of 658..2,879 sinks spanning up to 325 um; TritonCTS builds each cluster net alone (path depth 4..6) and the 8-sink top H-tree (570 um avg sink wire) does not see the subtree latency, so cluster roots arrive unequal.
